name: Program
longDescription: A COBOL program is a compiled unit that executes business logic and interacts with data files or databases.
examples: Example of a COBOL program with divisions and paragraphs.
notes: Programs are the highest-level execution units in COBOL.

longDescription: A JCL step defines a unit of work executed by the system, usually referencing a program and its parameters.

name: Dataset
longDescription: A dataset is a named collection of data stored on disk or tape, managed by the operating system.
